adjudication.rationale: The migration derives `category_id` via `SELECT c.id ... INNER JOIN site_settings AS s ON s.value = c.name WHERE s.name = 'embed_category'` and then immediately uses `[0]['id']`. This is verifiably an exact string match on `c.name` (case-sensitive in typical SQL setups) and will either (a) pick an arbitrary row if multiple rows match, or (b) return no rows and fall back to Uncategorized. It then deletes the original `embed_category` setting (`DELETE ... IN ('embeddable_hosts', 'embed_category')`), so a mismatch can permanently mis-migrate all hosts to the wrong category with no way to recover the intended category from settings.
